_readme: Time-boxed exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. An entry here suppresses one
advisory in one dependency tree until its expiry date, and not one day longer:
the gate FAILS on a past expiry, it does not warn. Renewal is a commit that
restates the argument, which is the only mechanism that has ever kept an
Every field is required and the gate rejects the file if one is missing.
id            GHSA identifier as it appears in the audit output
package       npm or PyPI package name
tree          one of: pnpm-workspace | site-bubble | discord-bridge | kokoro-server | tts-server
severity      as reported, so a silent escalation is visible in the diff
reason        why the fix is not being taken NOW (usually: it is a major bump)
reachability  why the vulnerable code path is not reachable from shipped code
owner         a person, not a team
expires       YYYY-MM-DD, at most 92 days out
reachability is the field that matters. If you cannot write a specific,
falsifiable sentence there, the honest move is to take the upgrade.

entries.reason: chatterbox-tts 0.1.1 hard-pins torch==2.6.0 and torchaudio==2.6.0 in its own metadata, so this cannot be upgraded without replacing the Chatterbox engine. Verified against the PyPI metadata for chatterbox-tts 0.1.1 on 2026-08-02, not assumed.
entries.reachability: The Fly app founderfirst-tts currently has no machines running, verified with fly machines list on 2026-08-02, so nothing serves this code today. Were it deployed, it accepts an audio script over a shared-secret endpoint called only by the content-audio edge function, and only for a voice profile explicitly set to chatterbox with a reference clip, never the default. Callers cannot pass tensors, model files or torch arguments, so the affected sequence-packing APIs only ever see the model's own inputs.
